credits.title: Better Off Dead
credits.overview: After his father's death, Gema, an awkward young man, is surprised by the warmth from his coworkers. When it fades, he begins to wonder who must die next, setting off a chain of lies that spirals into chaos.

credits.title: Cursed
credits.overview: Because of Rini's spell, Edi left his wife and two children. As a daughter who lost her father, Vita tried to win back her father's love and bring him back into the arms of his family.

credits.title: 13 Bombs
credits.overview: An organization races against time to uncover the mastermind behind the placement of 13 bombs in Jakarta before the city falls into chaos.
